message: All signs of people have faded, and only the chirping of insects echoes through the air.
It was just about to strike midnight.
The night sky over Sumiyoshi Academic Island was just a little darker than usual.
And no wonder—
The moon, which should have been pale white, was dyed crimson.

name: Iori
message: 「That's...」

name: Momiji
message: 「It's a total lunar eclipse.」
...Oh, right. They did mention something like that on the news the other day.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, isn't it just the perfect setting for a duel？」

name: Iori
message: 「You think so？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Doesn't it feel like it's going to be a special night?」

name: Iori
message: 「...I guess you're right.」
In the center of the training ground—right now, it's just me and Momiji here.
Setsugekka and Keisetsu will be arriving any minute now.

name: Iori
message: 「...I feel bad for Asahi and Ririmu.」
Asahi and Ririmu aren't here.
After Momiji and Keisetsu talked it over, they decided that this duel would be held strictly among those directly involved from the Kazamine and Suzakuin families.
I was granted special permission to attend as a witness, while Asahi and Ririmu were left behind to hold down the fort.

name: Momiji
message: 「A duel is a serious match, you know. It's not some spectacle.」
That's a pretty old-fashioned way of thinking...

name: Iori
message: 「So, Momiji, are you confident you can beat Setsugekka？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Of course. More like, winning is my only option.」

name: Momiji
message: 「There's no telling what Keisetsu would ask of me if I lost.」
Operation "Never Let the Green Grass Wither," which Momiji and I are currently carrying out, hinges on winning this duel.

name: Iori
message: 「...Still, wasn't promising to 'do anything she says, no matter what' going a bit too far？」

name: Momiji
message: 「If Keisetsu hadn't taken the bait, the operation would've failed right then and there. It was hardly the time to be stingy with the lure.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, yeah, that's true.」
Still, I can't shake the anxiety of what might happen if, by some slim chance, Momiji loses and gets hit with an outrageous demand.

name: Momiji
message: 「What, getting cold feet now？」

name: Momiji
message: 「You're the one who egged me on, Sensei, telling me to struggle until the very, very end.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If I lose and things go horribly wrong, you're taking responsibility right alongside me, okay, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「A-All right. I'll brace myself.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh, really？ You'll take responsibility for me？」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm the one who dragged you into this plan, so I'm the one in charge. I'll take final responsibility.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I see~ Well then, maybe it's fine if I lose~」

name: Iori
message: 「Hold on, Momiji-san？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Just kidding, just kidding! I'm definitely going to win.」

name: Momiji
message: 「No matter how many times we fight, I won't lose to Setsugekka.」

name: Momiji
message: 「The undefeated legacy of the Suzakuin—I'll drill that right into her.」
While we were talking, the two of them arrived.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting.」
Setsugekka already wore the face of a swordswoman.

name: Iori
message: 「...No need for small talk, then. Shall we get started right away?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Let's. What are the rules for the duel？」

name: Iori
message: 「Same rules as the Martial Festival. Once a Barrier Jacket drops below a set threshold, the match is decided. Any objections？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I have no problem with that.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Of course, I have no objections either.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'll serve as the Umpire.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hehe, I trust you'll officiate fairly.」
Keisetsu casts me a meaningful sidelong glance.
...It looks like she's already caught on that Momiji and I are in cahoots.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Good luck out there, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, I know.」
After confirming Keisetsu has stepped off to the side, I look toward both fighters.

name: Iori
message: 「Are you both ready？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yes」

name: Iori
message: 「Now then... both sides, take your stances！」
Setsugekka and Momiji—both draw their Origami at the same time and glare at each other.

name: Iori
message: 「Gather the myriad gods in divine assembly, deliberate in divine counsel. Heaven and earth be pure, the six senses be pure; purify us, cleanse us—」
I offer the <d0090>Norito</d> to the gods, and add a prayer of my own.
May the two of them be granted a happy future—

name: Iori
message: 「In the east, Kazamine Setsugekka！」

name: Iori
message: 「In the west, Suzakuin Momiji！」

name: Iori
message: 「—Spirits soaring, face to face, no holding back！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Now fight fair and square―begin―！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huff... huuugh, haaaaaaaaah...！！」
Rousing my inner god, Mizuchi, I lock my gaze on Momiji.
Unlike the Martial Festival finals, Momiji doesn't rush in to strike. I figured she wouldn't.

name: Setsugekka
message: （...You're in the state of Shohou Muga right from the start. That's how it is, isn't it, Momimomi）
If this really is like having Shingan no Kiwamete active at all times, just like Asahi―chan said―
Then my attacks are almost guaranteed to whiff, while hers are almost guaranteed to land.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Wait, no matter how you look at it, that's totally unfair...！）
Even so, nothing's going to happen if I don't attack.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Tch... don't get cocky...！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「―Self―Styled Type Kanoe: Kongouhou！！」
Planting my feet firmly on the ground, I shoot my fist straight out！
...Only Momiji is already gone from that spot.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why you—！！」
I unleash a flurry of blows, yet every single one cuts empty air, and on top of that—
Momiji's hand grabbed my wrist.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Guhhh！？」
And then, a fierce, utterly unavoidable upward slash.
I managed to wrench myself free by brute force the moment it hit, which saved me—otherwise, she would've followed up with a whole combo.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Damn it... if you hit me, I'll hit you right back！！」
A leap—closing in on Momiji in the blink of an eye.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Garyuu Type Mizunoe: Shiraotaki！！！」
I bring both my heel and my blade crashing down toward the crown of Momiji's head！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like I'll let you get away... Mishima-ryuu Type Kanoe: Hajoushou！！」
A strike poured with absolute confidence—yet with just a single centimeter left, my fist fails to reach.
Momiji had already stepped back in advance, retreating out of range.

name: Momiji
message: 「—Secret Art, Tsubame Gaeshi！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Guaah... N-Not done yet！」
Ignoring the damage, I chase right after the retreating Momiji.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Garyuu Type Hinoe: Enko Mouhazan！！！」
Charging forward, I unleash a flurry of strikes onto Momiji—！
...Only for every single one of them to be blocked.
On the backswing, Momiji sweeps her long blade at me, but I dodge it with ease.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Idiooot, like something like that could ever hit...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「—Secret Art, Tsubame Sanren！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ngaaaaaah？！」
That first strike was a feint—in the split second her swing ended, a succession of blinding flashes tore into me.
Sent flying back, I roll across the ground and barely manage to regain my footing.

name: Setsugekka
message: （...Dammit, what the hell am I supposed to do here?！！）
Kei-chan said winning this would be the chance of a lifetime, but right now I couldn't see a single path to victory.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...I did think it was awfully generous of you, offering to do one thing I say, whatever I want」
In short, she only said that because she knew there was no way she could ever lose.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, screw this, don't mess with me...！！」
With a roar, blood rushes straight to my head.
...What a load of crap, "This might be the last time you and I can face each other in a Jindou match."
Blowing smoke with pretty words while calculating her own victory down to the last detail. How clever of her.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Seriously... Just 'cause I'm an idiot, playing around with people's feelings like that...！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's the one thing that pisses me off the most！！！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, calm down！ You're going to lose control...！」
I can hear Kei-chan's voice.
But I didn't care about any of that anymore.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Honestly, being able to read every single one of your opponent's moves—that's just impossible...！）
How can she do something like that？ Because she's a Suzakuin？ If that's the case, God is way too unfair.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I even had to use a secret art just to finally catch up to you...！」
And yet, she brushes me off as if to say, 'Like I give a damn about that'—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then what the hell was my resolve even for...！！！」
I clench my teeth so hard they feel like they're about to shatter.
...Yeah, that's right.
I'm going overseas with Kei-chan.
So this is going to be the last match I ever get to fight against Momiji.
And I'm supposed to be fine with such an important match ending in a pathetic defeat where I couldn't even lay a finger on her？

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Like hell I am！！」
Then—there's no need to hold back anymore.
That's right... it's your turn, Mizuchi.
The other me, my incarnation.
...No, is that really true？
A single, simple question crossed my mind.
Where is the sad me when I'm not sad？ Where is the happy me when I'm not happy？
Where is the angry me when I'm not angry—？
Answer: nowhere.
Because they're all one and the same thing.
The two were never separate things to begin with. Together, the two make one self.
I'm only split in two because I'm a Saniwa, because there's a hidden chamber built inside me.
Then—let's put it back into its proper form.
I plunge both hands into the darkness at the very bottom of my heart and drag out everything inside, whole and intact—！
...Come on, let's become one again.
Think hard—whose rage is this？

name: Setsugekka
message: （It's mine—！）
Then who is the one who can truly unleash this rage—？

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's right, it's ME――――――！！！！！！」
Out of sheer astonishment, I was jolted out of the state of Shohou Muga.

name: Momiji
message: 「Se-Setsugekka...？」
Up until now, Setsugekka had been using her anger and frustration as a medium to draw power from the god within her, Mizuchi.
The "wind" had told me that much.
Yet suddenly, the "wind" surrounding Setsugekka warped grotesquely, enveloping her in a raging maelstrom.
And as a result—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Huh？ What do you want, Momimomi」

name: Momiji
message: 「Are you... losing control？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh heh heh, I'm not going berserk. You think I'd be calling you 'Momimomi~' if I were？」
Her brow furrowed and her face twisted, yet Setsugekka was still laughing. I could only feel bewildered by that warped expression.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I simply went back, that's all. To one me, to the real me.」

name: Momiji
message: 「The real Setsugekka...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'll show you what that means right now！！！」
Explosive speed—with no telegraphing at all, Setsugekka charged straight at me！
I barely managed to block her, only for her to drive me back in a blade lock.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, nghh...！！」
I couldn't hold her back. Even bracing myself with every ounce of my strength, my heels tore into the dirt as I slid backward.

name: Momiji
message: （W-What is this... She's even stronger than before...！）
She'd been plenty strong during the Martial Festival finals, too. Yet Setsugekka right now surpassed even that.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come on, here I go！ Mishima-ryuu Type Hinoto: Enga！！！」
Almost the exact instant her fist came at me—a rising kick slammed deep into my solar plexus.

name: Momiji
message: 「Guh, haaah......！！」
For an instant, I couldn't breathe.

name: Momiji
message: （What is this... She's too fast, I can't even...！！）
Setsugekka closed in on me while I was still airborne.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm not done yet！ Original Style Type Tsuchinoe: Houda Chouchuu Kai！！」
Setsugekka's elbow came flying at me with the speed of a cannonball, and I somehow managed to block it with my Origami.
My beloved blade, Tsubakuro Nagamitsu, shuddered with a shrill ziiing. Even though it was heavily reinforced with Tenju.

name: Momiji
message: （Are you insane?! If I took a hit like that head-on, my organs would rupture and I'd die...!!）
Clenching my teeth, I endured the impact and touched down.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hhhh... haaaah...」
An immediate deep breath—freeing my mind.
Entering the state of Shohou Muga, I brought Setsugekka into my sight—

name: Momiji
message: （What is this......）
What I saw—was a serpent coiling around Setsugekka.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh heh, you saw it, didn't you？ You went and saw it...？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「This... This right here is my true form...！！」
In place of the “path” I had always seen before, a “serpent” had taken up residence.

name: Momiji
message: （I see, so this is a Keyou...！）
A Keyou is, in essence, the same thing as the “wind” I had been seeing. A “vortex” formed within the flow of causality.

name: Momiji
message: 「……You've turned into something pretty creepy, haven't you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't act all high and mighty just 'cause you're a Suzakuin. Even you've got a dirty side or two, don't ya, asshole！！」
With zero defense, Setsugekka lunges in carelessly.

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't underestimate me……！！」
I can see the "path" woven by the wind of causality.
So if I just stay close to it and time my counter――
Setsugekka's fist slams straight into my face.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa there, guard up properly, ya know～, Momimomi. That pretty face of yours is gonna get smashed in！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, fuuuh…………！！」
Every single attack I throw is dodged, and every single attack Setsugekka unleashes lands――

name: Momiji
message: 「Hah…… haah, haaah……！」
Even over a Barrier Jacket, every single blow from Setsugekka hits outrageously hard.
Unable to take it head-on, I pull back and reset my stance.

name: Momiji
message: （W-Why…… how is this happening……！！?）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……Momimomi, you started seeing all kinds of stuff once you hit that Shohou Muga state, right？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still, at the end of the day, you're just 'seeing' it, aren't ya？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well see, I'm different……！！！」
I lock my eyes straight onto Setsugekka as she closes in.

name: Momiji
message: （It's fine, I can see the "path"――！！ ）
I mustn't let myself get thrown off.
Accept things as they are, feel them as they are, and unite my own actions with the flow of all things.
There can never be any mistake in the "path" of causality seen that way――
A split second ago, the serpent wrapped around Setsugekka sank its fangs into that "path".
――And slightly warped that "path."

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, guuuh……！！」
Setsugekka's fist drives right into my shoulder.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ora-ora-ora-ora-ora-AAAAAHHHH！！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ghk, aaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh！！」
A tremendous impact. Without even managing to break my fall, I rolled across the ground.

name: Momiji
message: 「W-What was that just now...？！」
I couldn't comprehend what had just happened.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Man, gods really are super convenient, huh? Being able to meddle with *causality* like this...！」
...Ah, so that's how it is.
Born from events and taking physical form—mononoke. If that is what a Keyou is, and what a god is.

name: Momiji
message: （They can alter the very nature of the "wind"—！）
From the very beginning, the Tenju we've wielded through Origami is itself an inhuman power born from events...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In other words, *I* have finally managed to surpass Momimomi...！」
Up until now, Setsugekka had been using her anger and frustration as a medium to draw power from the god within her, Mizuchi.
The "wind" had told me that much.
Yet suddenly, the "wind" surrounding Setsugekka warped grotesquely, enveloping her in a raging maelstrom.
And as a result—
Come to think of it, I heard someone say this a long time ago.
Why were the Ikusabito of old able to wield spirit blades so freely? Because they harbored gods within their own bodies.
An Ikusabito is a Saniwa who can fight. The ancestors of the Suzakuin family were Saniwa too.
And now, Setsugekka as she is right now is also—

name: Momiji
message: 「...No, you're not Setsugekka.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You're the Keyou Mizuchi, not Setsugekka！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even Mizuchi is a part of *me*！」

name: Momiji
message: 「No! Setsugekka and a Keyou are two completely different things!!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Geez, you're so stubborn, Momimomi！ I'm telling you, the Keyou in the hidden chamber was originally me！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The me that split off when I was little—that's *Mizuchi*！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh... T-That's impossible！ Think about it for a second！」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you just put something you cut apart back together, then why are you harboring a Keyou right now?！」
Simply reattaching something split in half can never make it greater than one.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hah, like I care about the tiny details！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It was locked away in a dark place for ages, so it probably just aged and fermented until it was reborn as a Keyou！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You idiot, as if that makes any sense！！！」
Does she think a Keyou is some kind of fermented food?
Yet this level of idiocy was undeniably Setsugekka's.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Tch, none of that crap matters...！ Only one thing does！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Right now, I'm stronger than Momimomi！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ghhhhhh...！！」
Setsugekka swings her mighty arm—I barely manage to block it, only for the impact to send my entire body flying.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm standing on equal footing with the great Momimomi right now！ N-no, even more than that！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm the one overwhelmingly winning here！！！」
The “path” of causality still lies before me.
Yet a path that gets twisted however she pleases along the way serves as no guide at all.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eat this！ Self-Styled Type Tsuchinoe: Axe-Blade Strike！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Uggghhhh...！！」
An impossibly heavy blow, as if catching a falling bridge girder.
Unable to withstand the sheer impact, I drop to my knees.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hahahahaha, what's wrong, what's wrong?！ Aren't you gonna use your prized state of Shohou Muga?！」

name: Momiji
message: （I've been using it from the very start...！！）
I had never once lost in a battle of reads before. Yet this Setsugekka—

name: Momiji
message: （...No good, I can't see it...！！！）
No matter what I tried, I couldn't see a future where I won.
Surging pessimism, the creeping scent of defeat. I tremble at a chill cold enough to freeze my very soul.

name: Momiji
message: （Ah... So this is what despair feels like—）
Only now do I realize it. Until this moment, I had never truly known despair.
No matter how difficult the situation, I had always been able to see a path.
Yet for that path to have a will of its own and evade me. I have never even imagined such a thing.
Against something like this—how am I supposed to win？

name: Momiji
message: （It's impossible...！ This is just a monster...！）
Halfway through thinking those words, I understood.
Why everyone drifted away from me back in elementary school. Why nobody wanted to have a match with me.
Just as it is with Setsugekka right now.
Because to them, I was a monster too—

name: Iori
message: 「Isn't that bad...！」
A little while after the match began, Setsugekka suddenly went berserk... or so it appeared.
The aura radiating from Setsugekka clearly surpasses anything human.

name: Iori
message: 「Keisetsu, maybe we should stop this.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...I wonder about that.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「This is a decisive bout with the futures of both Kazamine and Suzakuin at stake. I can't have you making rash judgments.」
Keisetsu shot me a pointed glare.

name: Iori
message: 「I know that, but what do you plan to do if something happens to Setsugekka...？！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It certainly looks like she might be going berserk, yet at least the way she fights is considerably calmer than usual.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's true enough, though……」
Even while adding her own twists to Mishima-ryuu Martial Arts, Setsugekka is switching between offense and defense and handling it brilliantly.
If she were running wild, it wouldn't turn out like this.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Rather, it might be that Setsugekka right now is the one truly mastering the secret art 'Tamukai.'」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If so, this is a golden opportunity to defeat Momiji. I can't just throw it away easily.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Please consider both sides' interests fairly and equally.」
Pinpointed like that, I let out a big sigh.

name: Iori
message: 「……Got it, let's watch a little longer.」
Keisetsu has a point too. Even I don't want to throw cold water on their fight for no good reason.

name: Iori
message: 「Still, if I think it's dangerous beyond this point, I'm stopping it.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, you are the Umpire of this match after all. I'll leave the final call to your judgment.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ooh, this is fun—it's the first time I've had a match like this！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Beating down an opponent who can't even fight back feels so damn good！」
For a while now, Momiji had been strictly on the defensive.
Her pinpoint reads sealed off, she has now fallen into a state where her hands and feet are completely torn away.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, tell me—what does it feel like to get beaten to a pulp and cornered by someone overwhelmingly stronger？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even though you know you don't stand a chance, what does it feel like when you still have to fight？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even though you can't reach no matter how far you stretch out your hand, what does it feel like when you still have to put up a tough front？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I know every single bit of it！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Because for years now! Over and over, dozens of times!! I've tasted feelings just like that!!」
My innate mental resonance was far too low, way too weak to keep going in Jindou.
Yet I had nothing else to rely on besides Jindou.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So I begged Kei-chan to make me strong with the secret art 'Tamukai'……！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I was told there'd be danger to my life too, but I didn't care about that at all！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Because, y'know！ Without being of any use at all, to anyone, getting compared to Kei-chan！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Spending my whole life getting called 'the useless one'—that's just plain hell！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So I was ready to throw my life away, whatever happened to me, because I wanted to get strong！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's how I barely managed to get into the academy！ And when I challenged Momimomi to a duel, all fired up—！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You ran all over the place and didn't even fight me! Do you remember what you said to me back then?!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「'I hardly possess the respect owed to some lowlife of unknown origin,' or something like that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Stop acting so high and mighty!!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Have you ever once imagined how painful and frustrating it was for me?!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wanted to get stronger, I wanted to surpass Momimomi, I wanted to know about you！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And when I got close, your room was always a mess and you were dressed like a slob！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Who do you think cleaned up that room for you?！ It was all me！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even after that, you never thanked me once, did you?!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What, you think it's only natural I do it for you? Is that the kind of upbringing Suzakuins get?！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No way！ Miyako-chan was a girl who could thank people properly！ She was a much better little sister than you were an older one！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In short, Momimomi, it's because you're arrogant！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Because you think I'm an idiot and you're looking down on me!!」
Putting up with all that, fighting fair and square.
……Yet I lost in the Martial Festival finals.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Saying I wanted to make it happen somehow so we could all spend time together in Takamura Class until graduation,」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I asked Kei-chan, got her to promise, worked hard, and fought with everything I had！」
Yet all that blood-sweat-and-tears effort, all the hard work up to that point, was effortlessly surpassed right before my eyes.
Crushed by my own sheer inadequacy.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even then, I swallowed it all, forced myself to endure it, and told myself I accepted it！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I was trying so hard to smile so we could part with smiles on our faces in our final class！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What is wrong with you?! 'If you're leaving, go right ahead,' seriously?!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't fuuuuuuck with me！！！！！」
I pour every ounce of my raging anger and pent―up passion into―my own fist.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Acting all 'I understand everything' with that smart head of yours, even though you totally get it！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You're ridiculously soft on yourself！ And not even a tiny bit gentle with anyone else！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Your」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That arrogant, prim-and-proper attitude of yours！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I fucking hate it―――――――！！！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ghk…… uuuugh…………！」
Mishima-ryuu Type Mizunoto: Banzetsu——
A palm thrust carrying absurd energy blasted me all the way to the edge of the outdoor training ground.
I couldn't read Setsugekka's moves or dodge them. Barely avoiding a direct hit by eye alone was all I could manage.
Irritation at that sheer unreasonableness wells up.
――No, that isn't what I'm really mad about.

name: Momiji
message: 「……I've been listening quietly for a while now, and you just say whatever the hell you want, don't you……！！」
My hand gripping the Origami creaks and groans. Blood vessels stand out on the back of my hand.

name: Momiji
message: 「What the hell do you mean, 'what does it feel like to be cornered in an overwhelmingly disadvantageous spot'！」
Tearing through dirt and gravel, I launch toward Setsugekka――！！

name: Momiji
message: 「You think I was just strong enough not to lose to anyone from the very start, huh！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「No fucking way I was！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I worked my ass off too！ I pushed hard out of sight and grew strong！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I've thought I might not be able to win plenty of times！ Even so, I got through it somehow！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Do you have any idea how sick I am of people watching from the outside with fake expressions and saying 'You're so strong~'!?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Could you possibly understand thataaahhll！！！」
I wasn't thinking about anything anymore.
Casting aside any state of Shohou Muga, I was swinging the Origami around purely in blind rage.
Dazzlingly blinding wrath, passion beyond words. Blazing flames of resentment drove me onward.

name: Momiji
message: 「No matter how hard I work, it's 'Of course, you're a Suzakuin'！ Everyone's just idiots looking at the sign plastered on my forehead！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka, you were like that at first too, weren't you！ 'I'll Definitely Beat Suzakuin-san Man' my ass！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because I'm carrying some stupid signboard like 'Suzakuin'！ I'm not even allowed a single loss！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Just how much have I suffered, forced to wear the collar of being undefeated! Have you ever even tried to imagine it?!」
If working hard meant being recognized, if someone would praise me for it. I'm sure I would've become a girl who could give it her all.
But nobody ever looked at my efforts. Working hard was a given; getting results was a given too.
Then why not just try hard where people can see? Why not just deliver the results they want and nothing more?
And just like that, I started slacking off out of sight.

name: Momiji
message: 「And then！ The moment I actually got strong, everyone started avoiding me instead！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Saying being around me just reminded them of how weak they were—pushing their own weakness aside and making me out to be the villain！」

name: Momiji
message: 「All my friends walked away from me until there was no one left！ Treated like a monster, shut out by everyone！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「And even then, I can never quit Jindou！ Not as long as I carry the Suzakuin name—never！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Could you ever understand how much I agonized over it?!」
So I lived all alone this whole time. Using Suzakuin's "standing alone" as a shield, I held fast to my solitude.
It wasn't like I was acting all high and mighty. I was simply terrified of getting close to anyone.
They're the ones who came up to me, and yet the moment I opened my window, they'd slam it shut for their own selfish reasons and walk away.
I went through that over and over again, and got hurt every single time.
So I built up walls, making them too high to climb over easily. That was the only way I knew how to protect myself.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Even so, you told me, didn't you, Setsugekka? That win or lose, we'd stay friends.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That as long as I kept wishing for it, you'd stay my friend forever！」
Shunned, pushed away, convinced that no one who truly understood me would ever appear for the rest of my life—
How happy I was, having believed that. How much it saved me.

name: Momiji
message: 「I always thought there was no way two swordfighters could stay friends—that it was completely impossible.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But with Setsugekka, with you, maybe—you made me believe that！」

name: Momiji
message: 「So one more time, just one more time... I genuinely thought I'd try trusting someone—that I wished we could be friends！」
And yet, even so—
Letting my rage take over, I launch strike after strike relentlessly.
Even faster than Tsubame Gaeshi—beyond even my own will, I slash away without a single thought.

name: Momiji
message: 「I knew, Setsugekka—I knew how hard you were trying so you could somehow stay with everyone in Takamura Class」

name: Momiji
message: 「I knew, but I had no choice but to win！ Losing wasn't an option I was allowed to take！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「So even after winning the tournament, even after becoming Toujinegi, I wasn't happy at all！！」
What I did is the same as Iori-sensei.
In exchange for victory, I stole my best friend's dream. I shattered my friend's earnest wish.
That's why it's presumptuous of me to wish for anything from Setsugekka. Something like that could never be forgiven.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Do you have any idea how I felt when I heard you were dropping out over summer break, Setsugekka？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even though I'd decided to try trusting you... even though I thought we'd finally become friends！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Without talking to me about anything, just deciding all on your own to leave the academy！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even though I kept telling myself I had no right to say anything, trying so hard to swallow it down！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「And what do you think you said to me then？」

name: Momiji
message: 「—If Momimomi really insists, I guess I could stay here for you, ya know？」

name: Momiji
message: 「D-D-Don't screw with me！！！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even as a joke, there are things you just don't say！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「With words I want to say but can't, words I have no right to say！ Putting me on the spot, messing with my head！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「When you don't have the slightest intention of staying at the academy no matter what I say, going and saying things to get my hopes up！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Did you even stop to think for a second how much those heartless words would hurt me?！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「That！」

name: Momiji
message: 「insensitive, flippant side of yours！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「pisses me off to death————！！！！！」
A breathless flurry of strikes—unable to dodge them all, Setsugekka eats hit after hit and tumbles clumsily across the ground.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Hah, what the hell is that」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Insensitive? Hey now, I sure as hell don't wanna hear that from Momimomi！！」
Setsugekka charges in—spinning into a sweeping slash.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then what, you're saying you're all delicate and considerate yourself, huh？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Take a look at yourself before you go spouting that crap！！」
Setsugekka's kick—I barely block it with my Origami.

name: Momiji
message: 「That's my line！」

name: Momiji
message: 「How am I arrogant？! You're way more arrogant than I am!!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph, arrogant and proud as a cock-a-doodle-doo！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Making light of it again like that……！ Knock off looking down on me！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm only acting like an idiot 'cause Momimomi's always looking down on people~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmph, you're not acting—you're a genuine idiot！ Don't get things twisted, you moron！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What did you say, punk?！ You stuck-up bastard！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Shut up, you dimwit face！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't bring up my face！！！」
Both of their strikes land cleanly――
Blown apart as if bursting, they collide again――crossing blades as if biting.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haa, haa…… Seriously though, Momimomi's got something totally wrong, doesn't she！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ha…… huuuh, got something wrong—what do you mean……！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even if I was abroad, even if we were apart, we could've stayed friends, right?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So isn't it weird that you're acting like I'm some heartless jerk who cut ties and said bye-bye？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's not good enough for me！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I want to be in the same class, in Takamura Class！ I want to keep going together！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaaaah？！ You're saying that now？！ Momimomi's the one who wrecked it all！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I know that！ That's why I was keeping quiet, and then you go saying stuff that rubs me the wrong way！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Read the room and figure out how I feel a little bit！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Listen here, 'figure out how I feel'—are you some delicate little thing?！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't ask me for stuff like that! Anyone spending time with me can tell I'm a rough, careless person!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even so, reading each other is what friends are supposed to do！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like I care！ Stuff like that's different for everybody！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Is that so？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？ Well, yeah. Are you saying I'm supposed to change my personality just 'cause we became friends？」

name: Momiji
message: 「So you're saying Setsugekka is, no matter how far you go, a rough, tactless, selfish, goofy person？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You—are you pickin' a fight with me?!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「People have good parts and bad parts, and that goes for everyone！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sometimes you click, sometimes you don't, sometimes you hold back or push too hard, sometimes you clash and make up！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even then, you don't let go of the hand you grabbed……！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That resolve is what 'being friends' means, right?!」
……Ah, I see.
It's annoying to admit it when Setsugekka's the one saying it, but I agreed.

name: Momiji
message: 「In other words, I was an idiot for expecting Setsugekka to have normal consideration」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The way you put it really ticks me off, but yeah, pretty much」
Now that it's been said, it was obvious, and it clicked right into place.
Apparently, I had been angry over something pretty trivial. Realizing that makes me a little embarrassed.
Setsugekka has plenty of shortcomings. But I have shortcomings too.
That's surely mutual, and without realizing it, we were complementing each other and keeping our balance.
My shortcoming is obvious.
It's conveying my true feelings honestly to the other person. I didn't have that courage.
Yes, I really had been saved by Setsugekka.
――And there's one more thing I realized.
My anger-driven attacks that I'd been unleashing just now――some of them were landing on Setsugekka.
Setsugekka should have had a way to completely shut down my reads. Yet why were my attacks getting through?
I understand the reason for that now, too.
By accepting things as they are and feeling them as they are, one can read the “path” born of the winds of causality.
However, as long as there is an 《I》 trying to trace that “path,” the realm of Shohou Muga is never completed.
Seizing that opening, Mizuchi was twisting the “path.”
Swept away by emotion, I completely ignored the “path.” In that case, twisting the “path” has no meaning.
In short, simply swinging the blade with an empty mind and trusting one's own intuition. That is the way not to give a Keyou an opening to exploit.
Those two realizations, seemingly unrelated, share a strange commonality. That is――

name: Momiji
message: （Move as freely as I please, is that it……）
That was the very thing I was worst at.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Hey, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Iori―sensei taught me something―」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, if there's something truly precious to you, don't give up.」

name: Iori
message: 「Even if it's pathetic, even if it's all in vain, you should keep struggling until the very end.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you give up on or let go of something precious so easily, you'll regret it for the rest of your life.」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, there's something that only you can do.」

name: Iori
message: 「There must be words that only you can get across—」
I relay Iori-sensei's words to Setsugekka just as he said them.

name: Momiji
message: 「Right now, I'm going to say everything I'm thinking out loud and tell you.」
I had never even thought of doing something like that before.
But—there must be something that only I can do.
I'll surely be clumsy and pathetic at it. It might be in vain, and it might not mean anything at all.
Still, if there's something truly precious to me, I mustn't give up.
Yes, that's why—

name: Momiji
message: 「Please don't laugh, just listen to me...！！」
Momiji lunges straight at me—！

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka, until I met you and Iori-sensei, I spent my whole life playing the honor student！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I put up walls, hid my real self away as much as I could, and made sure no one could ever touch me！」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's because I was weak！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because I was afraid of wanting someone, only to be betrayed！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「But the one who shattered those walls I built was Setsugekka—you！！」
I can't read Momiji's slash at all. Right now, she's swinging her blade with no regard for tactics or calculation.

name: Momiji
message: 「It's all because you reached out to me first, Setsugekka.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because I didn't have the courage to！」

name: Momiji
message: 「So, Setsugekka, I was truly happy I could become friends with you！」
I was just acting completely naturally, following my heart and doing whatever I felt like.
Yet that had been Momiji's salvation...

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, Setsugekka... I'll be lonely if you're gone！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Why are you leaving me behind and going abroad？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don't want that at all！！！！」
It was a cry from the very bottom of Momiji's heart.

name: Momiji
message: 「I don't want to say goodbye to you, Setsugekka！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Stay here at this academy and be my friend forever！！」
...I can tell, because I have Mizuchi's power.
How much courage Momiji is mustering just to say this much.
Things that are nothing to me are different for Momiji.
Because our birth and upbringing, our way of thinking, even the talents we were born with—everything about us is different.
For Momiji, honestly putting her feelings into words is many times harder than swinging a blade.
And right now, all of that courage of hers was directed straight at me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...I wanted that too」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wanted to be with Momimomi, and Sensei, and everyone！ I wanted to stay together at this academy！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's why I worked hard in my own way, and even made a promise with Kei-chan！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「All I had left to do was become the Toujinegi...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But it didn't come true！ Because I wasn't strong enough！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Because I was weak...！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's so frustrating, Momimomi！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka, I'm so sorry...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm the one who stole your dream, aren't I. Even though the dream you had, Setsugekka, was my dream too...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「At the very, very end, I hesitated！ Wondering if it was really okay for me to win like this...！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「But... if I held back, you'd notice. You would never be happy about something like that！」
Of course I would—just how long does she think I've been training alongside Momimomi.

name: Momiji
message: 「That's why I had to keep moving forward！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm truly sorry, Setsugekka...！！」
I know. Momiji didn't do anything wrong.
We both just did what was only natural. There was no grudge at all.

name: Setsugekka
message: （...Wait, huh？ I'm not angry anymore...？）
While I was being shaken by Momiji's earnest words. Those fierce, smoldering embers of anger had vanished completely.
Yet Mizuchi is still swirling around me even now. The vast power of Tenju still remains as well.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Ah, so that's how it is...！）
I had thought the filthy self deep in the darkness—that was Mizuchi, and the source of all my power.
But that's not it. The light inside me is also "me."
Acknowledging both and making them coexist.
That is where "I" ought to arrive—the ultimate destination of the secret art Tamukai.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I feel the same way, Momimomi！！」
At first, I wasn't looking at Momiji at all, only the nameplate of Suzakuin.
Yet as I interacted with Momiji, a sense of closeness gradually welled up. Before I knew it, I came to want to be friends.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Rivaling Momimomi, honing each other. You have no idea how much encouragement that gave me！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eating sweets together with Momimomi and talking all night long, it was so, sooooo fun！！！」
If my goal hadn't been Momiji. If Momiji hadn't been friendly with me like she is now.
I surely wouldn't have been able to push myself this far. I wouldn't even have made it into the Martial Festival main tournament.
I couldn't have spent such fun times, and I never would have wished to stay at the academy—！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaah, haa, haaah, haaaah...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Fuuuh... fuu, faaah... fuaaah...」
Catching ragged breaths against each other, I gaze at Momiji. There was no ill feeling left in my heart anymore.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, Momimomi...」

name: Momiji
message: 「What...？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...It's bittersweet, but let's wrap this up soon」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, that's right」
Which of us had the upper hand or the lower hand didn't matter at all. Trading blows and getting hit back, both of us were beaten ragged.
Honestly, my body doesn't look like it can hold out much longer.

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, at the very end—let's enjoy it」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, let's do that—！」
<s28>　　　　Because having a serious match with ―you―,　　　　　might just be the last time—！！</s>

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaaaaaaaaahhh！！！」
Momiji's barrage of strikes comes rushing in.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「My Own Style Type Kanoe: Kongouhou！！！」
My outstretched fist barely grazed Momiji.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Secret Selection: Tsubame Sanren！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Guuuh... as if I'd lose, My Own Style Type Hinoe: Enko Mouhazan！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Gah... I'm not done yet！！ Fivefold Swallow！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「—Original Style, Type Mizunoto: Hatou Ranbu Kai！！！！」
Kazamine and Suzakuin no longer matter.
All that's here are me and Momiji—just two swordswomen.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...This is fun, isn't it, Momiji！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, it's so much fun, Setsugekka...！！！」
Without a single worry, without a shred of hesitation—
Simply pouring our very way of life into our blades with utter purity, and fighting.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hah, haah, ugh... haaaah...！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Fwah, nngh... fuuuuh...！！」
It hurts, I can't catch my breath.
And yet, a smile naturally spills across my face.
Momiji returned it with a full, beaming smile.
For a swordswoman, could there be any greater honor than this?
I wish this moment could last forever.
I wish this battle would never end.
—And yet.
Everything must come to an end—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Gotcha, Momimomi！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I knew you'd come, Setsugekka...！！！」
I didn't see it coming. Just when I thought I'd grabbed Momiji's arm—
Instead, it was my arm that Momiji had tightly in her grasp.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Tch... fuck thiiiisss！！！！」
Before she could make her next move, desperate to break free, I violently swung my trapped arm around.
And flung Momiji high, high—up into the air.

name: Momiji
message: 「—Come at me, Setsugekka！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You bet！！！」
I kicked off the ground and soared into the crimson moonlit night.
I closed in on Momiji as she began to free-fall.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Suzakuin Momijiiii！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm！ The one！ Who's gonna beat you！！」
You were my goal, and the one I admired.
That's precisely why I have to defeat you—

name: Momiji
message: 「Kazamine Setsugekkaaa！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You！ I！ I'll definitely defeat you！！」
……I understand, Momiji.
You've recognized me as a full-fledged swordsman, your equal.
That makes me so happy――！
Gazing at each other, pouring every emotion into our own Origami.
We unleash our all-or-nothing strike――！！！

name: Momiji
message: 「――Secret Ultimate Art, Suzaku Enbu！！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「――Self-Taught All-Ten-Stems」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heaven-Wide Sovereign Blade！！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ngh, uuughh……！！」
Dropping to one knee on the earth.
Barely anything is left of my Barrier Jacket. Even maintaining Tenju is difficult.
I put strength into my legs, yet my knees only tremble.
I no longer had――any strength left to stand up.
Looking over at Momiji, she is standing straight on two feet.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Ah……my loss again, huh…………）
Just as I thought that.
The Origami Momiji had been holding shattered into pieces――
Momiji, silently and without a sound.
Slowly collapsed onto the earth――.
